name: NBA Live Mobile
summary:
NBA Live Mobile, where the NBA is powered by you. Whether you want to pick up and play a quick basketball game or settle in for a long session of completing challenges and dominating the court, you’re in total control of your NBA Live Mobile experience.

Dominate the court with a brand-new gameplay engine, stunning graphics, realistic basketball simulation gameplay, and the authenticity of live mobile NBA games right at your fingertips. Take on the NBA Tour and Limited-Time Live Events to polish your skills and earn new player items on your way to becoming the ultimate GM. Ready for a more competitive mode? Head to Rise to Fame, where you’ll take on harder and harder challenges and climb the leaderboards. And if you want to play with friends, unlock Leagues mode to create or join a League and take on special challenges.
